items.claim: Guidance recommends asking for confirmation before an action that cannot be undone, with dialog text stating the consequence, such as which item will be affected.
items.snippet: Ask for confirmation before an action that cannot be undone, and state the consequence in the dialog text, for example which item will be affected.

items.claim: Guidance advises offering an undo control instead of a confirmation prompt for actions that can be reversed.
items.snippet: Do not ask for confirmation for actions that can be reversed with an undo control; offer undo instead.
